column1: # Text measurement pinned by TextMeasureBaselineSpec: font.line.kind, comma-separated values. Skia's layout since
# #2660 item 2 step D2; AWT's numbers before it are in awt-reference.tsv, which only the parity report reads.
# Integers are exact; carets and widths (pixels) may differ by 0.01. If a change is intended, run
# `sbt writeTextMeasureBaseline` and commit this file with a line in the PR saying why the numbers moved.
